title: Sorceress on Lotus Pond
description: A woman with long flowing dark hair in a pink and red dress stands on water in a swirling vortex, holding a glowing green orb staff in one hand while magical blue orbs float from her other hand. She is surrounded by green and pink lily pads in a fantastical scene with dramatic swirling purple, red, and blue clouds above.
